violations.text: No person in charge or certified in food safety was present as needed at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

Cheese and lettuce was observed held at (48 & 51) degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC voluntarily disposed of product. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

(Various food product) was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

The screen door to the outside, located in the (back storage area ), is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

(Prep unit ) located in the (kitchen ) area was not in good repair. Ambient temperatures observed at 48DF.EStablishment not allowed to store any TCS products in unit until repaired and/or replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

The sink used for food preparation is lacking an air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. Establishment has an air break. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

The floors in back storage area have an accumulation of soil residue, food debris, and/or rodent droppings. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

The door to the outside, located in the (back kitchen ), is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Technician arrived to repair during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/13/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the (prep shelves ) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 04/13/2026

The sink used for food preparation is lacking an air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. Establishment has an airbreak. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 04/20/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (back outside) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 04/17/2026

The floors in the (back kitchen) are constructed of (concrete) which is not durable, easily cleanable, or non-absorbent. The materials for indoor floors must be durable, easily cleanable and nonabsorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. New Violation. Correct By: 05/13/2026
The ceiling in the (kitchen) area is covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. New Violation. Correct By: 04/20/2026
